name: io.github.pete-builds/unifi
title: UniFi Gateway
description: Safe-by-default UniFi MCP: Network + Protect + Access, multi-site, dry-run, audit log.

environmentVariables.name: STUB_MODE
environmentVariables.description: When true, the server returns realistic mock data and requires no UniFi hardware. Defaults to true. Set to false to manage a real gateway, which then needs UNIFI_HOST plus UNIFI_API_KEY (or UNIFI_API_KEY_FILE), or MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE. In either mode the HTTP transport will not start without MCP_UNIFI_AUTH_TOKENS.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUTH_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Bearer tokens that HTTP clients must present. Required: the streamable-http transport exits at startup with 'HTTP transport requires MCP_UNIFI_AUTH_TOKENS' when it is empty. Comma-separated; each entry is a bare token (named client-N automatically) or a 'name:token' pair. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNIFI_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: When true, every tool that changes state is hidden from tools/list and refused on tools/call; read tools are unaffected. Defense in depth on top of a read-only UniFi API key. Defaults to false.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_HOST
environmentVariables.description: IP address or hostname of the UniFi OS gateway (UCG-Fiber, UDM Pro, etc). Required when STUB_MODE=false and MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE is unset.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Local API key generated under Settings -> Control Plane -> Integrations on the gateway. Required when STUB_MODE=false and MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE is unset, unless UNIFI_API_KEY_FILE is used instead.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_API_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file inside the container that holds the local API key, for a Docker or Kubernetes secret mount. Wins over UNIFI_API_KEY when both are set. A controller configured this way verifies the gateway's TLS certificate unless UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL is set to false.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_PINNED_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file inside the container that holds the gateway's own certificate in PEM, recorded with mcp-unifi-pin-cert. When set, that certificate is the only one the server accepts from the gateway, and a mismatch fails every request. Do not set UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL to false alongside it: the server refuses to start.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_SITE
environmentVariables.description: UniFi controller site name. Defaults to 'default'.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Whether to verify the gateway's TLS certificate. Defaults to false because most home gateways use a self-signed cert.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a YAML file describing multiple named controllers for multi-site management. When set, the legacy UNIFI_HOST / UNIFI_API_KEY env vars are ignored. Each entry needs name, host, api_key, and optionally port, site, verify_ssl.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNIFI_MODULES_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of modules to load. Known values: 'network', 'protect', 'access'. Defaults to 'network'. Set to 'network,protect,access' to enable Protect and Access tools alongside Network. Access currently ships read-only; door unlocks and credential issuance require session-token auth and are deferred.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: UniFi Access hub IP or hostname. Required when the access module is enabled and STUB_MODE=false. Often the same host as UNIFI_HOST.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: UniFi Access API key. Separate from the Network API key; generated on the Access controller's developer settings. Required when the access module is enabled and STUB_MODE=false.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTPS port for the Access hub. Defaults to 12445 (the direct Access app port).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_SINK
environmentVariables.description: Audit log sink. One of 'file' (default), 'stdout', or 'syslog'. Every tool call is recorded to a JSONL stream with secrets scrubbed.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path for the audit log file when MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_SINK=file. Defaults to audit.jsonl in the process CWD.
